guard: TTL reconciliation reports success only after a real canary expires from the backing store. A file store whose metadata update rolls back while STREAM.INFO false-greens must raise TtlPersistenceError on both the update pass and a later matching-INFO pass.
why: The smoke constructs the exact file-store fault behind #404: a real stream starts at max_age=0,
only its metadata directory becomes 0500, nats-server accepts the update and INFO reports the new
TTL, while the store rolls back before age enforcement starts. The protected cell requires the
named persistence error rather than success. Healthy file and memory streams prove the detector
accepts stores that really expire the canary.

mutations.name: INFO-only acceptance is restored after STREAM.UPDATE, so the forced file-store rollback false-greens again
mutations.find:
await proveTtlEnforcement(jsm, js, streamName, bucket, ttlMs);
  return { stream: streamName, fromMs: fromNs / 1e6, toMs: wantNs / 1e6 };
